answer.headline: Decision requires architect judgement between enforcing one financial effect at posting boundary or in application cache
answer.reasoning: ALT-003 enforces idempotency at the ledger posting boundary, supporting the critical integrity driver QD-001 by ensuring at most one debit per instruction.
